title: Samsung is being fined in South Korea over Galaxy S21 and S22's gaming performance
description: The Korean Fair Trade Commission (FTC) sued Samsung over misleading marketing regarding the Galaxy S21 series, S22 series, and the Galaxy Tab S8 series, and the court decided to fine the tech giant. The reason is a marketing claim that the devices deliver "the ultimate mobile gaming experience," but fails to disclose that the so-called Game Optimizing Service (GOS) throttles the performance. Samsung's GOS automatically throttles the CPU and GPU performance on the said devices when playing demanding games. The throttling "feature" led to freezes, lags and lower graphics quality,...

title: New iPhone 18e leak covers its chip, cameras, and display
description: Digital Chat Station has shared details about the iPhone 18e before, and today the tipster is back on Weibo with a fuller picture of the iPhone 17e's successor. Apple launched the iPhone 17e in March, so a spring 2027 debut for the new model would fit the pattern, and the device has before been rumored to arrive alongside the iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2. According to DCS, the iPhone 18e will have a 6.12-inch LTPS OLED screen with a 60Hz refresh rate, so if you were hoping the "e" series would finally get a higher refresh rate, it looks like you'll have to keep waiting. It's also said to be...

title: Motorola Signature 27 and Razr Flex show up at a European retailer with prices
description: Motorola showed off the Signature 27 at Qualcomm's Snapdragon event last month, but it hasn't revealed the full specs or pricing yet. Now, Portuguese retailer MegaPC has listed the Motorola Signature 27, and reportedly the upcoming Motorola Razr Flex as well. The Signature 27 is listed in the Pantone Coal Smoke color with 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for €1,594.90. The page is currently marked as temporarily out of stock, and there's no word on when it will ship. The description mostly repeats what Motorola has already said: the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, a 200MP...

title: WhatsApp is bringing its media hub to iPhones
description: Last year, WhatsApp introduced a media hub on Mac and the web, which displays photos, videos, links, and documents from all of your conversations in one place. Now, the feature is on its way to iOS too, as spotted by digging into the latest WhatsApp beta (version 26.42.10.74). The media hub will live in the app's settings, and it will only show media you've received - so anything you've sent won't be there, and neither will disappearing media. It will have two tabs, New for recently received items and All media for everything. You'll be able to filter by photos, videos, or links, switch...

title: Samsung's next foldable leaks in official-looking renders
description: A few days ago a leaked image gave us our first look at Samsung's next foldable smartphone, the W27. This will be launching in China on October 29, as the latest member of the W series. The W devices are basically fancier China-only versions of the company's latest Z series book-style foldable. So this year, the W27 will be a Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra in a dark blue trim with gold accents. title: vivo X500 Pro in for review
description: The vivo X500 series only just became global, and we've got the X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max in the office, alongside the X500, which is not coming to Europe for now. The series is oddly lopsided, with the Pro Max towering over the Pro with a 6.85-inch display, and the X500 sitting in the middle with a 6.59-inch screen. The X500 Pro is the most compact at 6.36 inches. The global vivo X500 series The global vivo X500 Pro ships without a charger - you get a case and a USB-A to USB-C cable. The 90W charger is seemingly reserved for the Pro Max model. Unboxing the vivo X500...

title: Apple updates 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac with the M6 processor
description: Apple has updated the base 14-inch MacBook Pro and the iMac models with its latest generation M6 processor. The MacBook Pro was previously running the M5 chip from 2025 while the iMac was last updated in 2024 with the M4. The base 14-inch MacBook Pro model with the M6 processor gets a 12-core CPU with the 2+4+6 layout as well as a 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators in each core and hardware accelerated ray tracing support. There's also a separate dual 16-core Neural Engine. The base configuration includes 16GB unified memory that can be configured to 24GB or 32GB. Only the...

title: vivo X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max go global
description: Last month, vivo launched its X500 series in China, leaving many to wonder when the series would make its way to global markets. Well, the brand did just that today with the global launch of the X500 series. It consists of all three previously launched phones with the X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max all in tow. But as with past global rollouts from vivo, some regions like Europe won’t get the vanilla X500. The X500 is available in parts of Southeast Asia like Malaysia, where it starts at MYR 4,699 ($1,149 converted) in its 12/256GB trim and goes up to MYR 5,299 ($1,296) for the...

title: vivo X500 Pro Max review
The Infinix GT 50 Pro goes official in India
description: Six months after its global launch, the Infinix GT 50 Pro has finally made its way to the Indian market. The smartphone features a liquid-cooling system, RGB lighting, and is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultimate chipset. The Infinix GT 50 Pro is priced at INR 69,999 ($735) for the sole 12GB/256GB model. It is available for pre-order from the Infinix India online store and Flipkart. Official sales are set to begin on October 30. Everything about the phone remains the same as the global model. You get a 6.78-inch AMOLED display with 144Hz refresh rate and 4,500 nits peak...

title: Watch the vivo X500 series European launch here
description: The vivo X500 series is going global today, over a month after making its debut in China. The company's Austrian branch is holding a livestream event on YouTube, and we've saved you a seat. The event kicks off at 4:30 PM CET. We're expecting to see the X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max at today's event, while the vanilla X500 will remain China-only at least for the foreseeable future. Check in to our homepage after the event for pricing and availability details.

title: Instagram is testing long-form videos called Features
description: Instagram has announced that it is testing a new video format on the platform called Features, which will allow users to upload horizontal videos up to 90 minutes long. According to a report by The Hollywood Reporter, testing began on Monday and is currently limited to select creators in the US. However, Instagram has already been testing the feature with creators in Brazil, the report added. Instagram Vice President of Product Tessa Lyons and head Adam Mosseri have also shared details about the new long-form video format. The feature is primarily aimed at podcasters, allowing...

title: Xiaomi Smart Band 11 arrives in Europe
description: Following its announcement in China back in September, Xiaomi has now brought its Smart Band 11 to Europe. The fitness tracker is available directly from Xiaomi’s online stores across the region and it comes in two versions. There’s a standard model priced at €60 and an NFC-equipped version going for €80. From a quick browse on Xiaomi Spain, we can see the Band 11 comes in midnight black, glacial silver and mystic rose colors. Xiaomi is also advertising a ceramic white edition of the Band 11 but there are no pricing and availability details for now. As a recap, Smart Band 11 brings...

title: Apple responds to the iPhone Duo inner display cracking issue
description: Apple has responded to the reports regarding the iPhone Duo inner display cracking. In a statement to 9to5Mac, the company acknowledged that it is aware of the issue and has offered a basic suggestion. The company sent the following statement as a response (emphasis ours): "The response to iPhone Duo from early users has been incredibly positive, and we are seeing exciting things from developers who are rapidly updating their apps to take advantage of its unique form factor. We are aware of an issue impacting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units. If users...

title: iOS 27.2 update rolling out with these new features
description: Apple is seeding the iOS 27.2 update for supported iPhone models with several new features and fixes for over 160 security vulnerabilities. The iOS update brings new languages to Siri AI, Apple Pencil (USB-C) support on the iPhone Duo, and a lot more. Siri AI is now available in French, Korean, Japanese, Spanish, and Portuguese on the iPhone 15 Pro series and iPhone 16 models. The iOS 27.2 update also introduces Suggestions in Messages, Shared Albums in Photos, and support for SynthID watermarks in Photos and Image Playground. In the Apple TV app, users get a new Simple Profiles...

title: India's smartphone market just had its worst quarter in a decade, Counterpoint says
description: Last week, Omdia reported that India's smartphone shipments dropped 26% in Q3 to their lowest level since 2016. Now Counterpoint Research has published its own numbers, and while they're a bit less dire, they paint the same picture. Shipments apparently fell 20% year-on-year in July-September, to their lowest level in a decade. Unsurprisingly, record-high memory prices are to blame, since they drove up device costs. With demand staying soft, brands also kept less stock in stores, even ahead of the festive season. The cheaper end of the market took the hardest hit. Shipments of phones under...

title: Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max get listed by European retailer before their global launch
description: Xiaomi unveiled the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max in China back in September, and a day later it confirmed that both are going global. Today, Italian retailer Epto has listed the two phones ahead of their international debut, revealing their European prices, colors, and specs. The Xiaomi 18 Pro is listed at €1,398.90 with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage, and €1,591.90 with 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage. The 18 Pro Max only comes with 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage, for €1,783.90. Some Pro Max listings in white and Velvet Red, with different model numbers, are slightly cheaper...

title: Samsung's Exynos 2700 reportedly outpaces the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max's Snapdragon by up to 20%
description: Back in August, insiders claimed that the Exynos 2700 beat Qualcomm's next flagship chips in internal testing. Those Snapdragons have since become official, and Samsung has reportedly put its upcoming chip up against them once again. The Exynos 2700 is expected to power at least some models in the Galaxy S27 series, which should arrive early next year. This time, the tests were allegedly run against the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max and its Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6. The Exynos 2700 reportedly scored around 13,000 points in the Geekbench 6.5 multi-core CPU test, compared to around 11,000 for...

title: T-Mobile's new T-Mix plans let you pick your own perks
description: T-Mobile has recently been rumored to be preparing new T-Mix branded plans, and today they're finally official. There are three tiers, called Standard, More, and Loaded, and they'll be available in November. The big idea is that instead of coming with a fixed set of benefits, each plan gets a number of "Picks", which you can spend on the perks you actually want. T-Mix Standard starts at $55/month for one line with one Pick, T-Mix More is $75/month with two Picks, and T-Mix Loaded is $95/month with three Picks. All of those prices are with AutoPay, plus taxes and fees. On Loaded, the...

title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo key specifications leak
description: Motorola accidentally teased the yet to launch Edge 70 Neo back in August, which was followed by leaked renders later that month. The renders showcased the phone’s design and color options, but a new leak has now revealed its key specifications. According to the leak, the Motorola Edge 70 Neo will feature a 6.78-inch AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate. The handset is tipped to be powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset.
